## Technical reference

- [Dead EVF gamma tables](../reference/ep7-1100.evf-gamma-tables.md): EVF gamma tables in section 1 that the E-P7, which has no EVF, never programs.
- [Card updater task](../reference/ep7-1100.firmup-cli.md): Task 88 FIRMUP_CLI: picks the DCOLYMP E142????.BIN with the largest suffix above 0.
- [free](../reference/ep7-1100.free.md): Frees a block from malloc 0x60022782.
- [Section loaded mask](../reference/ep7-1100.loaded-mask.md): Bit (id-1) set by the loader per section.
- [Main container address](../reference/ep7-1100.main-container.md): Where the main program sits in the update container.
- [Main program CPU base](../reference/ep7-1100.main-cpu-base.md): Runtime base of the decoded main program.
- [malloc](../reference/ep7-1100.malloc.md): Fixed-block pools of up to 128, 2048 and 16384 bytes; logs an error above 16 KB.
- [Property getter](../reference/ep7-1100.property-getter.md): Reads a setting by property key (d0) and index (d1) from a RAM registry.
- [Section 1 free tail](../reference/ep7-1100.section-1-tail.md): Unused 0xFF bytes inside section 1's load; section 1 loads first.
- [Section loader](../reference/ep7-1100.section-loader.md): Copies each section and sets bit (id-1) in the loaded mask.
- [Section descriptor table](../reference/ep7-1100.section-table.md): Nine 12-byte entries: start, logical source, destination.
- [Settings facade vtable](../reference/ep7-1100.settings-facade.md): Vtable of the GUI settings facade the editor uses for every read and write.
- [Settings id table](../reference/ep7-1100.sid-table.md): Maps settings ids 0..1768 to a property key and index.
- [Update file validator](../reference/ep7-1100.update-validator.md): Checks header shape, model 0x1420 and every component's checksum before the first write.
- [Never write to the logical flash range](../reference/hazard.logical-flash-writes.md): Addresses from 0x40000000 up are the logical flash range.
- [Never CPU-read an image buffer through its raw descriptor address](../reference/hazard.raw-image-buffer-read.md): Image buffers must be read through the bus window mapper, row by row.
- [Only call code in a section that has already loaded](../reference/hazard.section-load-order.md): Sections load one after another; a hook calling a later section can run before its target exists.
- [Keep patch state out of the loaded firmware image](../reference/hazard.state-in-loaded-image.md): Stores into the loaded program image have restarted cameras; stock firmware does not make them.
